title: Fourth-moment product inequality
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $d$ and $e$ be any real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The square of the uniform expectation of $d(x)^2e(x)^2$ is at most the product of the uniform expectations of $d(x)^4$ and $e(x)^4$.
hypotheses_covered: $d,e$ are any real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
